name: astrocare
description: AstroCare: offline-first astronaut health monitoring and decision support (PinkSpectrum).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n app,api -c cyan,magenta --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 "npm --prefix app run dev" "npm run dev:api"
